pr_title: Add admission e2e tests for untested stable operations
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/80767

Adds e2e tests for:

- update and patch of {Validating,Mutating}WebhookConfiguration, then ensuring changes are effective
- delete and deletecollection (filtered by label) of {Validating,Mutating}WebhookConfiguration, then ensuring removal is effective

/sig-apimachinery
/sig-testing
/cc @liggitt @roycaihw @caesarxuchao @sttts 

```release-note
None
```

AdmissionWebhook should have tests for all stable operations.
Those tests should go through the conformance process before being released.
This ticket is to help track what operations are yet to be covered by conformance tests.

## 15 Untested Stable Operations need Conformance Tests

These stable endpoints should be hit by e2e tests tagged with [conformance].
There are tests currently hitting 6 of the corresponding beta endpoints that could be updated to use stable.
Tests should be written to exercise the remaining 9 untested stable endpoints as well.

## 12 Tests that hit 6 out of 15 Beta Operations

These twelve tests could be updated to use the stable API, and subsequently promoted to conformance.

[apisnoop.cncf.io tests for listAdmissionregistrationV1beta1ValidatingWebhookConfiguration](https://apisnoop.cncf.io/?showUntested=true&showTested=true&showConformanceTested=true&zoomed=operationId-beta-admissionregistration-listAdmissionregistrationV1beta1ValidatingWebhookConfiguration) / [test-grid](https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-release-master-blocking#gce-cos-master-default&include-filter-by-regex=AdmissionWebhook&show-stale-tests=)
